segments.text: Seventy-five percent of resumes never reach a human recruiter. Opaque ATS filters quietly reject qualified engineers every day.
Meet Hyper-Resume. A production-grade visual resume engine built for high-growth tech talent.

Export true selectable vector PDFs verified for ATS parsers, or download clean Jake's Resume LaTeX source ready for Overleaf.
Seamlessly transition into AI job description matching and STAR mock interviews grounded in your exact resume facts.
